summary: Two specialist orthodontists, 784 reviews and a clear free consultation offer are strong, but a wrong phone link and conflicting numbers cost you patients.

findings.problem: The emergency line shows 020 7247 5768 but the link dials 02072475678, so tapping it reaches a different number.
findings.cost: A patient in pain who taps to call may reach the wrong place.
findings.fix: A checked, working click to call link.

findings.problem: The cookie banner shows Manage {vendor_count} vendors and several {title} entries, and menu labels leak into the page (Close Treatments Open Treatments).
findings.cost: Unfilled code looks careless on a first screen.
findings.fix: A clean banner and tidy menus.

findings.problem: The page says More than 15,000 patients treated and 10,000+ smiles, 30 years and 20 years of experience, and More than 600 reviews next to 4.8 - 784 User Reviews.
findings.cost: Conflicting numbers make patients doubt every claim.

findings.problem: The header Book a free consultation goes to /special-offer/ while others go to /consultation/, the same page is labelled Kids+ and Teens+, no before and after shows, and the awards are not named.
findings.cost: Mixed booking paths and unnamed awards reduce trust.
findings.fix: One booking path, captioned results and named awards.

redesign: A working call link, one booking path and a clean first screen.
One verified set of figures with captioned before and after results.
